fields.statement: Roadmap rows 404 because /api/roadmap?all=true reaches across the root's projects, so a project's roadmap shows another project's change sets and their rewritten /p/<this>/changes/<id> links aren't found. Accepted change set 01M79S4M (web-roadmap-project-scoped) already scopes each project's API to that project. How should this bug change set 01M79SMG be planned?
